description: Looks up a company's LEI in the GLEIF database: by LEI code (with entity status, registration status, BIC and direct and ultimate parent company) or by company name (possible matches, optionally filtered by country).

country.description: Optional two-letter country code for a name search.

lei.description: A 20-character LEI code. If lei is given, name is ignored.

name.description: Company name, if no LEI is known.

name: find_lei
title: Find Legal Entity Identifier (LEI)
